title: Kindred
author: Octavia E. Butler
summary: A young Black writer in 1970s California is pulled back in time to a Maryland plantation. There she repeatedly saves the life of a white boy who will grow up to be her ancestor, and the visits grow longer and more dangerous.
readIf: you want a gripping, unflinching novel that uses time travel to make history feel personal.
skipIf: you want to avoid detailed depictions of slavery, including whipping and sexual violence.

pairings.reason: Another powerful novel about the lasting human damage of slavery, in a more lyrical and ghostly form.
More from the same author, about survival and belief in a society that treats people as disposable.
